en.headline: Cheuk says birth package may have slowed a steeper fall
en.dek: The deputy chief secretary told LegCo the government's medium-term aim is to stop a cliff-edge drop in births, and he reserved judgment on restoring a universal student grant.
body: Deputy Chief Secretary Cheuk Wing-hing told the Legislative Council's manpower panel on Wednesday that Hong Kong's mid-term goal is to keep the birth rate from falling off a cliff, and that the drop would likely have been steeper without the government's package of incentives.

The latest Policy Address added 11 measures covering cash support, housing and childcare. New People's Party lawmaker Dominic Lee said more than 77,000 people had received the newborn bonus in recent years, yet last year's fertility rate remained low, and he asked how the government would measure results. Cheuk said the bonus had a 99.9 percent take-up rate and that births rose after it was introduced in a dragon year before falling again. He said advanced economies everywhere face the same problem and Hong Kong would not copy neighbours without weighing its own finances.

Cheuk reserved his position on restoring a HK$2,500 student grant cancelled in last year's Budget, saying the payment is not means-tested and the government prefers targeted support. Labour sector members asked for longer maternity and paternity leave and a statutory parental leave for all workers; Labour and Welfare Secretary Chris Sun said statutory maternity leave is 14 weeks and paternity leave five days, and any change must balance the economy and employers' capacity. Cheuk said the government can encourage family-friendly practices at companies but cannot compel them.

zh.headline: 卓永興：無組合拳生育率跌幅或更嚴重
zh.dek: 政務司副司長在立法會表示，中期目標是避免出生率斷崖式下跌，並對重推二千五百元學生津貼有保留。
body: 政務司副司長卓永興星期三在立法會人力事務委員會表示，政府中期目標是管控出生率下跌，避免出現斷崖式下跌，並認為若沒有鼓勵生育「組合拳」，跌幅可能更嚴重。
新一份《施政報告》推出十一項加強版措施，涵蓋經濟、住屋及託兒支援。新民黨議員李梓敬指，過去幾年已有超過七萬七千人領取新生嬰兒獎勵金，但去年生育率仍低，關注如何衡量成效。卓永興回應，獎勵金使用率達百分之99.9，龍年推出後出生數字一度上升其後回落。他強調出生率下跌是全球先進經濟體共同面對的問題，香港須量力而為，不會單純跟從鄰近地區。
實政圓桌議員莊豪鋒建議重推去年預算案取消、每名中小學及幼稚園學生二千五百元的學生津貼。卓永興指津貼毋須經濟審查、金額亦不小，在現時財政狀況下政府希望精準扶貧，因此有保留。勞工界議員要求增加產假、侍產假，以及把現時政府僅員每年三天育兒假擴至全港。勞工及福利局局長孫玉菬指法定產假為十四星期、侍產假五天，任何改動須顧及經濟、社會及僱主承擔能力。卓永興說政府可引導企業推動育嬰友善措施，但不能強制。
